entries.text: Borealis Optics registers one purpose statement for its catalogue and defers the component classification of each item to that item's registered product record.
Borealis Reading Loupe: a hand-held magnifier with an achromatic doublet. The registered listing records neither a documented intended use nor a component classification.
Registered product terms. Intended use: close reading of printed documents. Component classification: this loupe is assembled with no refurbished parts and no reconditioned optics.
